title: Record id
description: The identifier a record carries for itself and for the records it points at: an https URI on a domain its issuer controls, as GS1 CBV 2.0 section 8.4.4 names a location and as an EPCIS 2.0 document names any object without a GS1 key. Each issuer chooses the path below its domain; an id, once issued, never changes and is never reused. The URI need not resolve, and where it does it returns the record or its description. It carries no query and no fragment.
